target: Next.js implementation of the selected Flowboard HTML screens, followed by live integration only with backend-verified endpoints
mandatoryCriteria: The intended project, board, sign-in, invitation, My Tasks, inbox, activity, people, trash, settings and import journeys have real responsive pages or an explicitly documented deliberate unavailable state.
A dynamic board route uses its board ID and does not display another board's fixture data. Combined view includes authorized boards only within one selected project.
Visible actions perform their documented behavior or have a clear disabled state with reason. No fake save, invite, restore, upload, comment or grant-success feedback.
Card creation requires an explicit priority and preserves the draft on validation or network failure. Completed states use the approved pastel green semantic tokens.
Typecheck and production build pass. Keyboard, narrow-screen and full-screen navigation are checked. A fresh independent UI review records the exact target and limitations.
Live integration uses only backend-reviewed endpoints, shows pending/error/conflict/permission states and is verified against isolated synthetic PostgreSQL before any release claim.
requiredChecks: browser checks for route/navigation and core actions
exclusions: Production deployment remains a separate stage after integrated acceptance.
